citation.title: Development of an ultrafast charge exchange spectroscopy system on the KSTAR tokamak
citation.authors: J. Y. Jang, W.-H. Ko, Y. Li, M. von Hellermann, Y. Shi, Y. S. Hwang
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1063/5.0043824 (this paper's own DOI, PDF p1-2 header; DOIs in the reference list belong to cited works)

scope_read.pdf_pages: 1-6 (p1 publisher cover; p2-6 = article pp. 053525-1 to -5), including Figs 1-7, Table I, Eq. 2
scope_read.limitations: Proceedings-length design paper. Fig. 4b legend shows Ti=Te=1 and 5 keV, while Table I lists 2 and 5 keV; this is an internal inconsistency, and the source does not resolve it. SNR is computed via Eq. 2 inside the SOS code. No measurement uncertainties are reported.

claim_checks.proposed_claim: UFCES is a design plus simulation and bench test, not measured plasma data
claim_checks.source_finding: Spectra and SNR come from SOS forward modeling. The only measurement is a Ne-lamp/CMOS bench test, which confirmed a linear dispersion of 0.36 nm/mm and a slit curvature radius of 41.24 mm. First plasma results were anticipated for the 2021 campaign.
claim_checks.locator: PDF p2 Abstract; p4-5 Sec III A, Table I, Fig 4; p6 Sec III B, Fig 7; p6 Sec IV
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: An ultrafast CES system has been designed for KSTAR, and its expected performance has been assessed through spectral forward modeling and a spectral-lamp bench test [Jang2021].
claim_checks.qualification: Do not describe it as having measured plasma Ti or rotation fluctuations.

claim_checks.source_finding: Two added fiber arrays view ρ≈0.6 and 0.7. Each position maps to 16 PMT channels on a 32-channel linear PMT. The simulation used ρ=0.6 only.
claim_checks.locator: PDF p3 Sec II; p3 Fig 1b; p4 Fig 2a, Fig 3; p4 Table I
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: The design targets two radial positions simultaneously, using high-throughput optics, a transmission grism and a fast multi-anode PMT [Jang2021].
claim_checks.qualification: These are design positions. Nothing in the source links them to a pedestal-top chord or to the KSTAR 2022 configuration.

claim_checks.source_finding: The 10 μs integration time (100 kHz) is a design and simulation input. With it, SOS predicts SNR well above an acceptability threshold of 10 (e.g., ~61-90 across the Fig 4 cases). Fig 1b lists the PMT/digitizer design as 100 kHz, up to 1 MHz.
claim_checks.locator: PDF p2 Abstract; p3 Fig 1b; p4 Sec II end; p4 Table I; p5 Sec III A, Eq 2, Fig 4
claim_checks.allowed_intro_sentence: Simulations indicate that a 10 μs integration time could yield adequate signal-to-noise for this design [Jang2021].
claim_checks.qualification: The 10 μs figure is simulated, not demonstrated on plasma. It is integration time, not end-to-end report latency or availability.

input_target_timing.inputs: C VI 529.05 nm charge-exchange spectrum from NBI (hardware); the simulation used assumed profiles
input_target_timing.outputs: Planned Ti and toroidal rotation at two radii
input_target_timing.reported_vs_physical_truth: Simulated synthetic spectra; no comparison with independent truth

validation.independent_truth: not_applicable; the bench test checks dispersion and curvature only
validation.unknowns: Plasma performance; realized SNR; calibration; data-processing latency

runtime_or_deployment.what_was_measured: Ne-lamp bench test of the spectrometer's dispersion and slit curvature only
runtime_or_deployment.what_not_established: Operation on plasma; real-time inversion; latency of Ti/v reports; availability in campaigns
runtime_or_deployment.locator: PDF p6 Sec III B, Sec IV

forbidden_inferences: Do not state that UFCES has delivered KSTAR plasma measurements, or that 10 μs resolution was demonstrated.
Do not state that UFCES covers our provider-selected 2022 pedestal-top chord.
Do not state that UFCES makes downstream nowcasting unnecessary or redundant.
Do not use integration time as a stand-in for report arrival latency.
Do not present Fig 4 SNRs as measured values.
competing_or_complementary: Complementary upstream route: faster spectral acquisition could refresh CES anchors more often. Our method instead estimates the current conventional CES report before it is available, using BES/ECEI snapshots. Any actual interaction between the two remains unvalidated.
followup_sources_if_material: Any later KSTAR UFCES plasma-results paper. Its existence was not checked here; verify before citing.
Li et al., Fusion Eng. Des. 146, 522 (2019) (source ref 19)
